hints.tr: `plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)` iki alana tek y ekseni verir.
hints.en: `plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)` gives both areas one y axis.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def compare(a, b):
    fig, (left, right) = plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)
    left.plot(a)
    right.plot(b)
    fig.savefig("compare.png")
    same = left.get_ylim() == right.get_ylim()
    low, high = left.get_ylim()
    plt.close(fig)
    return [same, [round(float(low), 1), round(float(high), 1)]]

print(compare([10, 20, 15], [100, 120, 90]))
```

The full solution:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def compare(a, b):
    fig, (left, right) = plt.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)
    left.plot(a)
    right.plot(b)
    fig.savefig("compare.png")
    same = left.get_ylim() == right.get_ylim()
    low, high = left.get_ylim()
    plt.close(fig)
    return [same, [round(float(low), 1), round(float(high), 1)]]

print(compare([10, 20, 15], [100, 120, 90]))
```
